candidates.description: This vector represents German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.
This vector represents common German action verbs in their inflected present tense forms.
This vector activates for German nouns, adjectives, and lexical morphemes spanning diverse topics.
This feature vector activates on capitalized two-letter syllables or abbreviations commonly found in names, titles, or chemical symbols.
This vector activates for common German adjectives and adverbs expressing qualities, importance, or states.
These tokens represent German pronominal adverbs and locative adverbs frequently occurring at the start or middle of clauses.
This feature vector activates on common German subwords, prefixes, and root morphemes.
This vector represents common adjectives describing physical properties, scale, or quality.
These tokens are common German adverbial and functional modifiers expressing negation, quantity, degree, and state.
This vector is related to German adjectives and determiners preceding nouns in plural or inflected forms.
